text:
Elaine Chen: Quick heads-up — all-hands tomorrow 10:00am PT (link in calendar). Agenda draft below, please drop Qs here or add to the doc: https://docs.redwood.com/allhands/spring-reset

Agenda:
1) Exec state & priorities (Sam)
2) Dedicated launch recap + SLA highlights (Mike)
3) Policy update: data retention & Private deployment controls (Priya)
4) Incident recap: last week's cross-region latency spike (eng-sre)
5) Product demos & customer stories
6) Q&A + wrap

Elaine Chen: Also two asks — keep slides to 2 mins/slide and upload to the shared folder by EOD today. We'll record and share within 24h. :camera_flash:

Mike Alvarez: Can we add a 5-min deep dive on cost optimization recommendations? important for customers moving to Dedicated.

Elaine Chen: Good call — slotting 5m after the Dedicated recap.

Sophia Patel: Q: Will the incident RCA slides be part of the deck? I'm consolidating SRE notes.

Priya Reddy: Yes — Priya will present the policy changes (data retention windows + optional KMS controls). Slide will include the timeline and migration checklist.

Sam Liu: I'll cover company priorities and a short hiring update (eng + infra). Heads up: we'll call out the new metrics we care about (latency P95, cost/unit, uptime).

Taylor Morgan: Reminder for managers: we'll run a 10-min post-all-hands sync at 11:15am PT for action assignment. Please clear calendars if you own a slide.

Mike Alvarez: Adding a note — we should mention the Dedicated burst capacity pilot and who to contact for invites.

Elaine Chen: Noted. Mike, please add contact info on your slide (email + slack handle).

deploy-bot: Incident #2026-03-18 SUMMARY: cross-region KV-cache invalidation caused 15m of elevated latencies (P95 up 2.3x). Mitigations: reverted caching rollout, traffic rebalanced. Follow-up: config hardening + test playback planned.

Priya Reddy: For the policy update: main change is default data retention from 180 -> 90 days for hosted API logs. Customers can opt into longer retention for Dedicated/Private. We'll include a migration playbook.

Sophia Patel: Suggestion — include a link to the incident replay and CI test that caught the regression. Saves time during Q&A.

Elaine Chen: Good idea. Sophia, please paste that link here when you have it.

Sam Liu: Quick note on exec talking points: emphasize unified runtime & cost controls as our competitive angle.

Taylor Morgan: Logistics: childcare reimbursement for in-person attendees is available — ping me if you need it.

Mike Alvarez: +1 on cost controls. Also will call out Optimize tooling improvements and a sample config we recommend.

Priya Reddy: Will mention compliance timelines for EU customers and KMS integration steps.

Sophia Patel: Here's the incident replay: https://playbacks.internal.redwood/2026-03-18/kv-cache-replay (internal).

Elaine Chen: Awesome — I'll add that link to the incident slide.

Sam Liu: Any last-minute agenda requests?

Mike Alvarez: None from my side.

Priya Reddy: All good.

Taylor Morgan: FYI recording will be auto-uploaded to the #all-hands channel and the team drive within 24h — we'll pin it.

Elaine Chen: Thanks all — see you tomorrow. Please keep replies brief so folks scrolling can skim. :sparkles:

Sam Liu: See you.

Mike Alvarez: Thanks — prepping slides now.

Sophia Patel: Will upload SRE RCA slide by 6pm PT.

Taylor Morgan: Post-all-hands action owner doc: https://docs.redwood.com/allhands/actions (please add owners during the sync).
